messages.content: This is **Destination Rolodex**, a destination card you can drop into any page. Scroll the country list and the photo blends into the next one; switch between Morph Blend and Liquid Warp on the demo page.

suggestedPrompts: Add three more destinations with their own photos
Add a third transition that wipes the photo from the globe outward
Show the local time at the selected destination under the caption
Make the card load destinations from a JSON file on the web
